description_en: This topic describes how to call the EnableAutoTopicCreation operation to enable or disable automatic topic creation and modify the default number of partitions for automatically created topics
description_zh: 本文介绍如何调用 EnableAutoTopicCreation 开启和关闭自动创建Topic，以及修改自动创建 Topic 默认分区数
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka enable-auto-topic-creation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs20000 --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableAutoTopicCreation

parameters.help_en:
Currently only these three request parameters are supported:

enable: Enable automatic topic creation.

disable: Disable automatic topic creation.

updatePartition: Modify the number of partitions for automatic creation
parameters.help_zh:
目前只支持这三种入参：

enable: 开启自动创建 Topic。
disable: 关闭自动创建 Topic。
updatePartition: 修改自动创建分区数
parameters.name: operate

parameters.help_en:
Adjust the default number of partitions for automatically created topics.

This value is passed only when the Operate value is updatePartition, or when UpdatePartition is true
parameters.help_zh:
调整自动创建 Topic 默认分区数。


当 Operate 值为 updatePartition 时，或者 UpdatePartition 为 true 时，才传递该值
parameters.name: partition_num

parameters.help_en:
Modify the number of partitions for automatic creation.

If this parameter is set to true, the Operate parameter must be updatePartition or left empty
parameters.help_zh:
修改自动创建分区数。

若该参数设置为 true ，Operate 参数需为 updatePartition 或者不填
parameters.name: update_partition

Code.description_en: Return code. A return value of 200 indicates success

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
